title: It's stuck, Dad — the zipper won't move up at the top.
scene: 拉链头卡在领口高处，孩子够不着也看不清，站凳子凑近才发现布料夹住了。

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: It's stuck, Dad — the zipper won't move up at the top.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: The pull is stuck way up by your collar.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: But I can't reach it up there, it's too high for me.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You can stand on the little step stool to get closer.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Oh no, now I can see it — the fabric is caught in it.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Hold the fabric flat, and then pull it. There, it's free!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You're welcome. Zippers can be sneaky sometimes.
